note: Scripture is Cadman’s Kinh Thánh (1925), pasted by script; John 4:23-24 follows Cadman’s bằng tâm thần và lẽ thật. The English marks some of Murray’s quotations with straight apostrophe entities; those places are mirrored as they stand.

AI-translated (job #6178); reader address bạn. The English source has several slips (e.g. “you cannot glorify” for can, “insincerity” for in sincerity, “For thy is the kingdom”), translated by their evident sense. Awaiting native review.
